name: ENKI Display Field Routing Pack
description: Per-entity-type list of structured-profile fields to surface in the entity dossier UI. Same algorithmic pattern as researchpack.source_routing: a single map from canonical_type → ordered field-priority list. The entity card pulls Wikidata/Wikipedia structured_profile data, then filters it through this pack to show only the fields that are *meaningful for this type*. Adding a new type (vessel, aircraft, person, country, organization) means updating this pack — never editing UI code. Field order in the list = display order on the card. NAMESPACE FIX (2026-07-25): namespaces_owned was ['display.profile'], which did not own this pack's own definition ids; added the namespace actually used so the admission ceremony's ownership check passes.

metadata.author: ENKI System
metadata.change_control: Adding a new entity type to type_profiles → no code change required. Adding a new FIELD to the universe of known fields → may need a corresponding entry in display_label_map + display_kind_map for nice rendering. Removing fields is safe (they just stop showing up on cards).
